problem_statement:
BUG#30445128 `PRIVILEGE_CHECKS_USER` MUST NOT FORCE `REQUIRE_ROW_FORMAT` TO BE SET

[post-push]

Description/Fix
---------------

1) A condition tying `PRIVILEGE_CHECKS_USER` value with `REQUIRE_ROW_FORMAT` was
   forgotten in `Relay_log_info::read_info` method.

2) The `rpl.rpl_log_info_repository_persistence_require_row` test started to
   fail due to errors exposed by the change in _1)_:

   a) Some of the test-cases were still linking the both options, that is fixed.

   b) A use case testing for the proper value of `REQUIRE_ROW_FORMAT` when
      `PRIVILEGE_CHECKS_USER` is set, was removed. Is now reinstated.

3) Other tests had result content mismatch due to the change in _1)_, fixed now.

RB: 23456
